messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1901234567 — Service: inference-api; Severity: Sev2. Elevated 5xx rate detected in us-west-2 starting 1901234501. Pager: @Emily T. Alert link: <https://alerts.redwood.ai/1901234567>
Emily T: I'm on it, investigating logs and pod health. I've pinned the alert and started a trace.
Chris L: Observable spike on replica group cg-4, memory climbs then 503s. Looks like repeated OOMs triggering retries.
SRE Lead: Good catch. Proceed with graceful drain + restart on the affected nodes. Avoid full rollout until we confirm reduction in errors.
Emily T: Doing drain+restart on cg-4 (3/8 pods). Command I'm running:
```bash
kubectl drain cg-4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data && kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```
incident-bot: automated mitigation: scaled inference-runtime replicas to 12 (was 8) as temporary burst.
Emily T: After rolling restarts error rate is trending down to baseline. Monitoring 5xx over the next 10m.
Maria G: Drafting status page entry for public update: 
```markdown
We experienced elevated 5xx error rates for the Redwood Inference API (us-west-2) between 1901234501 and 1901234660 UTC. Impact: intermittent request failures and increased latencies for some customers. Mitigation: restarted impacted pods and temporarily increased replica count. Current status: mitigated; we are continuing to monitor and will post follow-ups.
```
Alex P: Suggest we include an ETA for full verification and mention customers can request credits if they saw service impact.
Chris L: Quick SLA eligibility note: SLA is 99.9% monthly uptime. For an event window we calculate per-customer downtime minutes. If customer downtime exceeds their SLA threshold for the billing period we offer a pro-rated credit per contract. I'll pull the affected account list and sample logs.
Billing Bot: Querying customer subscription and recent usage for impacted region... (job queued)
Emily T: Handing off to billing once we confirm affected accounts and exact window. Tagging @Billing Bot and @Maria G for customer comms.
Billing Bot: Job complete. Found 12 customers with at least one sustained failure period > 5 minutes within the window. Comp calculation prepped. Example output: 
```json
{"account": "acct-123", "downtime_mins": 12, "credit_minutes": 12}
```
Maria G: Customer email template draft: 
```text
Hi <Customer Name>,

We want to inform you of an incident on <date> affecting Redwood Inference in us-west-2. Between <start> and <end> UTC we observed elevated 5xx errors which may have impacted your requests. We have mitigated the issue and are offering SLA credits where applicable.

To process any credits, please confirm the affected project IDs and billing contact or respond with 'no action required' if you were not impacted. You can also submit the details via: https://billing.redwood.ai/credits

Apologies for the disruption,
Maria on behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Emily T: Add a line clarifying no action required if unaffected, and include a link to the support ticket for follow-up.
Maria G: Done. Also preparing the internal compensation spreadsheet for finance with account IDs and proposed credit amounts.
Chris L: For handoff to SRE/finance include: start/end timestamps, affected models, count of 5xx, sample request IDs. Use this helper to pull samples:
```bash
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group /redwood/inference --filter-pattern '5..' --start-time 1901234501000 --end-time 1901234660000 --limit 500
```
ops: Acknowledged. I'll start the credit run once Billing confirms contact details. Need approval from SRE Lead to issue credits.
SRE Lead: Approved. Credits per SLA: prorated by downtime minutes relative to monthly subscription. Looping in Legal for any special contract clauses.
Chris L: Also flagging Optimize team — investigate batching settings / KV cache pressure that coincided with the spike. Might be a tuning follow-up.
Billing Bot: Preparing draft credit memos for the 12 accounts. Requesting primary billing contacts for 4 accounts (no contact on file).
Alex P: I'll outreach with the customer template, attach the estimated credit amount, and request confirmation of affected project IDs. Will post replies here.
Emily T: Closing operational incident (mitigated). Root cause (preliminary): autoscaler reactive delay combined with node memory limits on model shards causing transient OOMs. Action items: increase pod memory headroom for hot shards, tune autoscaler target to reduce time-to-scale, add early alert for KV cache saturation.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1901234567 marked RESOLVED at 1901234710. Duration: 143s from detection to mitigation actions in place.
Maria G: Final internal note: creating postmortem draft under /postmortems/1901234567 and attaching compensation ledger and customer reply tracker.
Billing Bot: Credit issuance complete for 8/12 accounts; 4 pending customer confirmation. Ledger reference: CM-1901234567-01.
Alex P: Thanks all — will update with customer confirmations and final credit memos. :thumbsup:
